data.text:
Pavan Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Drugs Inspector
Food ... on 3 January, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench 
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:337
Court No. - 27 
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 12803 of 2023
Applicant :- Pavan Kumar Yadav 
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Drugs Inspector Food Sefety And Drugs Administ. Di 
Counsel for Applicant :- Shitla Prasad Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Shitla Prasad Tripathi, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manish Kumar
Pandey, the learned A.G.A-I, for the State. 
2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to
quash the entire criminal proceedings of case and set aside the order dated 29.09.2023 passed by
the learned Additional District and Session Judge, court No. 7. Faizabad, in Compliant Case No.
12/2020, under Section 18c/27 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, State of U.P. through its
Drugs Inspector, Food Safety and Drugs Administration, Office District Magistrate, Sultanpur vs
Pawan Kumar Yadav and another. 
3.  The applicant was summoned to face the trial on a compliant under Section 18c/27 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 by means of an order dated 02.03.2022 in complaint no. 12/2020. The applicant had filed an application under Section 482 Cr.P.C No. 9713 of 2020 challenging the validity of the summoning order and the application was disposed of by means of an order dated 22.12.2022 by observing that there was no ground to set aside the impugned proceedings but the Pavan Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Drugs Inspector Food ... on 3 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96025053/
1 applicant was granted 15 days time to surrender and apply for bail.
4. The applicant has failed to avail the opportunity granted to him by means of an order dated 22.12.2022 and he has approached this court after issuance of bailable warrant consequent to his non appearance.
5. As this court has already disposed of and an application under Section 482 filed by the applicant by means of the order dated 22.12.2022 providing 15 days time to the applicant to appear and apply for bail and the applicant did not avail that opportunity, there is no illegality in the order issuing bailable warrant consequent to non appearance of the applicant 6. In view of the aforesaid facts, this application lacks merits and the same is accordingly dismissed. 
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 3.1.2024 Preeti.
